TFT17_Item_ASTraitEmblemItem.name: Challenger Emblem
TFT17_Item_ASTraitEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Challenger trait. On takedown, the holder's next @NumAttacks@ attacks each heal for @PercentHealthHeal*100@% of max health.

TFT17_Item_AssassinTraitEmblemItem.name: Rogue Emblem
TFT17_Item_AssassinTraitEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Rogue trait. At @HealthThreshold*100@% health, gain @Omnivamp*100@% Omnivamp and immunity to crowd control for @BuffDuration@ seconds.

TFT17_Item_AstronautEmblemItem.name: Meeple Emblem
TFT17_Item_AstronautEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Meeple trait and @DamageAmpPerMeep*100@% Damage Amp and @HealthPerMeep@ Health per %i:set14AmpIcon%.

TFT17_Item_DRXEmblemItem.name: N.O.V.A. Emblem
TFT17_Item_DRXEmblemItem.desc:
The holder gains the N.O.V.A. trait.

N.O.V.A. Strike: Gain @ASStriker*100@% Attack Speed and @ArmorStriker@ Armor and Magic Resist. Other allies gain @ASTeam*100@% Attack Speed and @ArmorTeam@ Armor and Magic Resist.

TFT17_Item_DarkStarEmblemItem.name: Dark Star Emblem
TFT17_Item_DarkStarEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Dark Star trait.

TFT17_Item_FavoredEmblemItem.name: Arbiter Emblem
TFT17_Item_FavoredEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Arbiter trait.

TFT17_Item_FlexTraitEmblemItem.name: Voyager Emblem
TFT17_Item_FlexTraitEmblemItem.desc:
The holder gains the Voyager trait.

Combat Start: The holder and allies within 1 hex in the same row gain a bonus based on the holder's role.
- Tanks: @BonusArmorMR@ Armor and Magic Resist
- Fighters/Assassins: @BonusOmnivamp*100@% Omnivamp
- Other Roles: @BonusAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed

TFT17_Item_HPTankEmblemItem.name: Brawler Emblem
TFT17_Item_HPTankEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Brawler trait. Attacks deals @PercentHPAttack*100@% of the holder's max health as magic damage.

TFT17_Item_MeleeTraitEmblemItem.name: Marauder Emblem
TFT17_Item_MeleeTraitEmblemItem.desc:
The holder gains the Marauder trait and has a @GoldDropChance@% chance to drop @GoldAmount@ gold on kill.

Gold dropped this game: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Item_GoldGenerated@

TFT17_Item_PrimordianEmblemItem.name: Primordian Emblem
TFT17_Item_PrimordianEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Primordian trait.

TFT17_Item_PulsefireEmblemItem.name: Timebreaker Emblem
TFT17_Item_PulsefireEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Timebreaker trait.

TFT17_Item_ResistTankEmblemItem.name: Bastion Emblem
TFT17_Item_ResistTankEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Bastion trait. After the first @Delay@ seconds of combat, the holder gains @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.

TFT17_Item_ShieldTankEmblemItem.name: Vanguard Emblem
TFT17_Item_ShieldTankEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Vanguard trait. Gain @APGain@% Ability Power whenever an ally gains a shield.

TFT17_Item_SpaceGrooveEmblemItem.name: Space Groove Emblem
TFT17_Item_SpaceGrooveEmblemItem.desc:
The holder gains the Space Groove trait. On cast, the holder enters {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}} for @GrooveDuration@ seconds.

Can only occur once every @ICD@ seconds.

TFT17_Item_StargazerEmblemItem.name: Stargazer Emblem
TFT17_Item_StargazerEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Stargazer trait.

TFT17_Item_SummonTraitEmblemItem.name: Shepherd Emblem
TFT17_Item_SummonTraitEmblemItem.desc: The holder gains the Shepherd trait. On cast, grant @ManaSharePercent*100@% of max Mana to the Bond of the Stars.

TFT_Item_AdaptiveHelm.name: Adaptive Helm
TFT_Item_AdaptiveHelm.desc:
Gain an additional @ManaPercIncrease*100@% Mana from all sources. The holder gains an additional bonus based on their Role:

Tanks and Fighters: Gain @FrontlineResists@ Armor and Magic Resistance.

Other Roles: Gain @BacklineADAP@% Attack Damage and Ability Power.

TFT_Item_ArchangelsStaff.name: Archangel's Staff
TFT_Item_ArchangelsStaff.desc: Combat start: Gain @APPerInterval@% Ability Power every @IntervalSeconds@ seconds in combat.

TFT_Item_Bloodthirster.name: Bloodthirster
TFT_Item_Bloodthirster.desc: Once per combat at @HealthThreshold@% Health, gain a @ShieldHealthPercent@% max Health Shield that lasts up to @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

TFT_Item_BlueBuff.name: Blue Buff
TFT_Item_BlueBuff.desc: Gain @ModifiedADAP*100@% additional Attack Damage and Ability Power from all sources.

TFT_Item_BrambleVest.name: Bramble Vest
TFT_Item_BrambleVest.desc:
Gain @PercentMaxHP*100@% max health.

Take @AutoDamageReduction*100@% reduced damage from attacks. When struck by any attack, deal @1StarAoEDamage@ magic damage to all adjacent enemies.

Cooldown: @ICD@ seconds

TFT_Item_Crownguard.name: Crownguard
TFT_Item_Crownguard.desc:
Combat Start: Gain a @ShieldSize@% max Health Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

When the Shield expires, gain @ShieldBonusAP@% Ability Power.

TFT_Item_Deathblade.name: Deathblade
TFT_Item_Deathblade.desc:
Perfect peace and calm for the holder - and all who face it.

@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT_Augment_TragicalBlade_TRAKey@

TFT_Item_DragonsClaw.name: Dragon's Claw
TFT_Item_DragonsClaw.desc:
Gain @PercentMaxHP*100@% max health.

Every @HealthRegenInterval@ seconds, heal @PercentHealthDamage@% max Health.

TFT_Item_ForceOfNature.name: Tactician's Crown
TFT_Item_ForceOfNature.desc:
Your team gains +@MaxArmySizeIncrease@ max team size.

@PercentGoldChance@% chance to drop 1 gold when you win combat.

"...the Heart of a hero..."

TFT_Item_FrozenHeart.name: Protector's Vow
TFT_Item_FrozenHeart.desc:
Combat Start: Gain @CombatStartMana@ Mana.

At @HealthThreshold@% Health, gain @TriggerMana@ Mana and a Shield equal to @ShieldHealthPercent@% max Health.

TFT_Item_GargoyleStoneplate.name: Gargoyle Stoneplate
TFT_Item_GargoyleStoneplate.desc: Gain @ArmorPerEnemy@ Armor and @MRPerEnemy@ Magic Resist for each enemy targeting the holder.

TFT_Item_GuardianAngel.name: Edge of Night
TFT_Item_GuardianAngel.desc: At @HealthThreshold@% Health, briefly become untargetable, shed negative effects, and heal @MissingHealthRestore*100@% missing health.

TFT_Item_GuinsoosRageblade.name: Guinsoo's Rageblade
TFT_Item_GuinsoosRageblade.desc: Gain @AttackSpeedPerStack@% stacking Attack Speed every second.

TFT_Item_HextechGunblade.name: Hextech Gunblade
TFT_Item_HextechGunblade.desc:
Heal the lowest percent Health ally for @AllyHealing*100@% of damage dealt.

Ally Healing: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Tracker_Value1@

TFT_Item_IonicSpark.name: Ionic Spark
TFT_Item_IonicSpark.desc:
@MRShred@% Shred enemies within @HexRange@ hexes. When enemies cast an Ability, deal magic damage equal to @ManaRatio@% of the Mana spent

Shred: Reduce Magic Resist

TFT_Item_LastWhisper.name: Last Whisper
TFT_Item_LastWhisper.desc:
Damage from attacks and Abilities @ArmorReductionPercent@% Sunder the target for @ArmorBreakDuration@ seconds. This effect does not stack.

Sunder: Reduce Armor

TFT_Item_Leviathan.name: Nashor's Tooth
TFT_Item_Leviathan.desc: Attacks grant @BaseManaOnHit@ bonus Mana, increased to @ManaOnCrit@ if they critically strike.

TFT_Item_MadredsBloodrazor.name: Giant Slayer
TFT_Item_MadredsBloodrazor.desc: Gain @DamageAmp*100@% additional Damage Amp against Tanks.

TFT_Item_Morellonomicon.name: Morellonomicon
TFT_Item_Morellonomicon.desc:
Attacks and Abilities deal @BurnPercent@% Burn and @GrievousWoundsPercent@% Wound to enemies for @BurnDuration@ seconds.

Burn: Deals a percent of the target's max Health as true damage every second
Wound: Reduces healing received

TFT_Item_NightHarvester.name: Steadfast Heart
TFT_Item_NightHarvester.desc:
Gain @BaseDurability*100@% Durability. While above @ThresholdForEmpower*100@% Health, instead gain @EmpoweredDurability*100@% Durability.

@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT_Augment_WarmogsBuckle_TRAKey@

TFT_Item_PowerGauntlet.name: Striker's Flail
TFT_Item_PowerGauntlet.desc: Critical Strikes grant @BuffDamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp for @Duration@ seconds, stacking up to @MaxStacks@ times.

TFT_Item_Quicksilver.name: Quicksilver
TFT_Item_Quicksilver.desc:
Combat Start: Gain immunity to crowd control for @SpellShieldDuration@ seconds.

Gain @ProcAttackSpeed*100@% stacking Attack Speed every second.

TFT_Item_RabadonsDeathcap.name: Rabadon's Deathcap
TFT_Item_RabadonsDeathcap.desc:
This humble hat can help you make, or unmake, the world itself.

@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT_Augment_DeadlierCaps_TRAKey@

TFT_Item_RapidFireCannon.name: Red Buff
TFT_Item_RapidFireCannon.desc:
Attacks and Abilities @BurnPercent@% Burn and @HealingReductionPct@% Wound enemies for @Duration@ seconds.

Burn: Deals a percent of the target's max Health as true damage every second
Wound: Reduces healing received

TFT_Item_RedBuff.name: Sunfire Cape
TFT_Item_RedBuff.desc:
Gain @BonusPercentHP*100@% max Health.

Every @ICD@ seconds, deal @BurnPercent@% Burn and @GrievousWoundsPercent@% Wound to an enemy within @HexRange@ hexes for @BurnDuration@ seconds.

Burn: Deals a percent of the target's max Health as true damage every second
Wound: Reduces healing received

TFT_Item_Redemption.name: Spirit Visage
TFT_Item_Redemption.desc: Regenerate @MissingHealthHeal*100@% of missing Health each second.

TFT_Item_RunaansHurricane.name: Kraken's Fury
TFT_Item_RunaansHurricane.desc: Attacks grant @ADOnAttack*100@% stacking Attack Damage, up to @MaxStacks@ attacks. After @MaxStacks@ attacks, gain @ASCapstone*100@% Attack Speed.

TFT_Item_SpectralGauntlet.name: Evenshroud
TFT_Item_SpectralGauntlet.desc:
@ARReductionAmount@% Sunder enemies within @HexRange@ hexes. Gain @BonusResists@ Armor and Magic Resist for the first @BonusResistDuration@ seconds of combat.

Sunder: Reduce Armor

TFT_Item_StatikkShiv.name: Void Staff
TFT_Item_StatikkShiv.desc:
Damage from attacks and Abilities @MRShred@% Shred the target for @MRShredDuration@ seconds. This effect does not stack.

Shred: Reduce Magic Resist

TFT_Item_SteraksGage.name: Sterak's Gage
TFT_Item_SteraksGage.desc: At @HealthThreshold@% Health, gain a Shield equal to @PercentHealthShield*100@% of the wearer's maximum Health that rapidly decays over @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

TFT_Item_TacticiansRing.name: Tactician's Cape
TFT_Item_TacticiansRing.desc:
Your team gains +@MaxArmySizeIncrease@ max team size.

@PercentGoldChance@% chance to drop 1 gold after @Timer@ seconds of combat.

"...and a bit of Luck."

TFT_Item_TacticiansScepter.name: Tactician's Shield
TFT_Item_TacticiansScepter.desc:
Your team gains +@MaxArmySizeIncrease@ max team size.

@PercentGoldChance@% chance to drop 1 gold when the holder dies.

"Imbued with a Philosopher's wisdom..."

TFT_Item_ThiefsGloves.name: Thief's Gloves
TFT_Item_ThiefsGloves.desc:
Each round: Equip 2 random items.

[Consumes 3 item slots.]
@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT_BindOnEquipTRA@

TFT_Item_TitansResolve.name: Titan's Resolve
TFT_Item_TitansResolve.desc:
Gain @StackingAD*100@% Attack Damage and @StackingSP@% Ability Power when attacking or taking damage, stacking up to @StackCap@ times.

At full stacks, gain @StackedAmp*100@% Damage Amp and gain immunity to crowd control.

TFT_Item_UnstableConcoction.name: Hand Of Justice
TFT_Item_UnstableConcoction.desc:
Gain 2 effects:
  • @AD_NotStatBar*100@% Attack Damage and @AP_NotStatBar@% Ability Power.
  • @StatOmnivamp_NotStatBar*100@% Omnivamp.

    While above @HealthThreshold*100@% health, double the Attack Damage and Ability Power. While below @HealthThreshold*100@% Health, double the Omnivamp.
